title: capabilities.files
description: The `files` provider's block of a freedom-manifest/2 `capabilities` object. See providers/files.md §6.

private.description: files:private — read and write the dapp's own private folder (consent tier).

read-shared.description: files:read-shared — read files in the shared pool, narrowed to `scope` (consent tier).

write-shared.description: files:write-shared — add, overwrite, delete, rename, copy into and setPublication on the dapp's own shared files (consent tier).

mimePattern.description: A MIME type (`image/png`) or a type-family pattern (`image/*`).

author.description: A dapp key (providers/files.md §8.1, SPEC.md §3.2), or the literal `user` or `agent`.

sharedReadScope.description: Scope of files:read-shared. An omitted field means all.
